    client ON account.district_id = client.district_id

    district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE 
    loan.amount < 100000
GROUP BY 
    district.A2,
    CASE

        WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'

        WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'

    COUNT(*) AS total_loans
FROM 
    loan
JOIN 
    account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN 
    client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
JOIN 
    district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE 
    loan.amount < 100000
GROUP BY 
    district.A2,
    CASE 
        WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'
    END;

sql:
SELECT 
    client_id,
    age,
    average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        age,
        average_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS oldest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_salary ASC) AS lowest_salary_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            client_id,
            age,
            average_salary
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                c.client_id,
                EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) AS age,
                d.A11 AS average_salary
            FROM 
                client c
            JOIN 
                district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
            WHERE 
                c.gender = 'F'
        )
    )
)
WHERE oldest_rank = 1 OR lowest_salary_rank = 1;

    client_id,

    average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        age,
        average_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS oldest_rank,

        SELECT 
            client_id,
            age,
            average_salary
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                c.client_id,
                EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) AS age,

                client c
            JOIN 
                district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

                c.gender = 'F'
        )
    )
)
WHERE oldest_rank = 1 OR lowest_salary_rank = 1;

                client c
            JOIN 
                district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

                c.gender = 'F'
        )
    )
)

SELECT 
    client_id,

        client_id,
        age,
        average_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS oldest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_salary ASC) AS lowest_salary_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            client_id,
            age,
            average_salary
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                c.client_id,
                EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) AS age,
                d.A11 AS average_salary
            FROM 
                client c
            JOIN 
                district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
            WHERE 
                c.gender = 'F'
        )
    )
)
WHERE oldest_rank = 1 OR lowest_salary_rank = 1;

                client c

SELECT 
    client_id,
    age,
    average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        age,
        average_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS oldest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_salary ASC) AS lowest_salary_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            client_id,
            age,
            average_salary
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                c.client_id,
                EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) AS age,
                d.A11 AS average_salary
            FROM 
                client c
            JOIN 
                district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
            WHERE 
                c.gender = 'F'
        )
    )
)
WHERE oldest_rank = 1 OR lowest_salary_rank = 1;

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region;

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        (SUM(loans_with_no_issues) * 100.0 / SUM(total_loans)) AS overall_avg_percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues ON total_loans.region = loans_with_no_issues.region
    AND total_loans.loan_size_category = loans_with_no_issues.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    t.region,
    t.loan_size_category,
    (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues,
    o.overall_avg_percentage
FROM 
    total_loans t
JOIN 
    loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region
    AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
CROSS JOIN 
    overall_avg o;

    t1.region,
    t1.loan_size_category,
    t1.total_loans,
    t2.loans_with_no_issues,
    (t2.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t1.total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) AS t1
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues

        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY

WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region;

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region)
ORDER BY 
    region;

sql:
SELECT 
  (completed_races * 100.0 / total_japanese_drivers) AS completion_percentage
FROM 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT result.driverId) AS completed_races
   FROM results AS result
   JOIN drivers AS driver ON result.driverId = driver.driverId
   JOIN races AS race ON result.raceId = race.raceId
   WHERE driver.nationality = 'Japanese'
   AND race.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
   AND result.time IS NOT NULL) AS completed,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driver.driverId) AS total_japanese_drivers
   FROM drivers AS driver
   JOIN results AS result ON driver.driverId = result.driverId
   JOIN races AS race ON result.raceId = race.raceId
   WHERE driver.nationality = 'Japanese'
   AND race.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009) AS total;

         FROM

            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id

            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id

         WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
         GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END) AS t1
     JOIN 
        (SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues

            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id

            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

  (completed_races * 100.0 / total_japanese_drivers) AS completion_percentage

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, overall_average FROM (WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category) ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, overall_average FROM (WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category) ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN

                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'

        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage

            total_loans t

            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region)
ORDER BY 
    region;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, overall_average FROM (WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category) ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, overall_average FROM (WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category) ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, overall_average FROM (WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category) ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
